about_the_game:
Throwia: The Next-Generation Social MMO Rogue-like Game!

Throwia is a turn-based, throw-mechanic-based MMO rogue-like game built entirely around player freedom. Players design their own characters and fight to become popular and powerful in this dynamic world. But Throwia isn’t just about battles—it stands out with deep customization options and rich social interactions!

Character Customization

In Throwia, creating your dream character is entirely in your hands! In addition to classic elements like hair, face, t-shirts, pants, and shoes, you can also express yourself with facial cosmetics, different ear types, and various skin tones.

Moreover, poses are also customizable and wearable. So, you can stand out not just with your outfits but also with your stance and unique style!

Weapons & Strategy

Throwia's combat mechanics are turn-based and built around throwing. The game features a variety of unique weapons that are not just cosmetic but also offer strategic advantages!

You can customize your attack style by placing different gems into your weapon slots, altering attack effects, and gaining an edge over your opponents. Create your own playstyle and dominate the battlefield!

Rogue-like Adventures

Embark on perilous adventures across islands to grow stronger and obtain new gear!

Explore islands filled with various missions and challenges, solo or with friends.

Hop on your ship and navigate through randomly generated islands.

Battle different enemies, make choices through mysterious question marks, and influence the stories on each island.

Each adventure brings new maps, fresh challenges, and unique loot waiting to be discovered!

Tournaments & Fame

Power in Throwia isn’t earned just through adventures! Arena battles are where the strongest players clash.

Players who grow stronger in adventures can form guilds and battle others in the arena.

Large-scale tournaments are held at regular intervals. Winners are crowned as the best in the world of Throwia!

Their names are displayed in the city center and in-game screens, turning them into true legends!

In Throwia, everyone can write their own legend!

Design your character as you wish, choose the weapons that suit your play style, level up, and get stronger in the rogue-like adventures.. For new equipment, blast or dig your opponents... Build your team and reach the top of the rankings! 💣
